materiality_analysis.reason: This is a structural consolidation (merge) of three disclosures into one. The 2025 text summarizes the 'Application Development and Data Services Portfolio' and 'Tanzu AI Solutions' into a cohesive narrative. While specific details about Tanzu Platform governance and Tanzu Data warehouse capabilities are summarized, the core business activity (providing app dev and data services) is unchanged. The shift to highlighting 'AI application development' as a central theme is consistent with existing Tanzu AI Solutions disclosure and reflects a marketing emphasis rather than a new strategic pivot.

comparisons.peer_summary: AMD continued investing in the open ROCm software stack, making key optimizations and adding features in the latest release to improve performance for generative AI workloads and simplify the developer experience.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD highlight investments in AI-focused software ecosystems to enhance developer experience and performance for generative AI workloads. AVGO’s Tanzu Platform includes 'Tanzu AI Solutions' to help teams deliver generative AI applications quickly and safely. Similarly, AMD invested in its ROCm software stack, making key optimizations to increase performance in generative AI workloads and simplify the developer experience.

sentences.text: • Tanzu Platform: This cloud native application platform accelerates software delivery, providing platform engineering teams with enhanced governance and operational efficiency while reducing toil and complexity for development teams. Tanzu Platform includes access to content including enterprise-ready curated distributions of open source software technologies used for storing and processing data. It also includes Tanzu AI Solutions, a set of capabilities that help application teams deliver generative AI-powered, intelligent applications quickly, safely, and at scale. Tanzu Platform also offers teams full-stack visibility from applications to infrastructure and efficient modern application lifecycle management across public and private clouds with Cloud Foundry and/or with any conformant Kubernetes.

During the year, we made several key optimizations and additional features in the latest AMD ROCm software that increases performance in key generative AI workloads, adds expanded support and optimization for additional frameworks and libraries, and simplifies the overall developer experience.

comparisons.peer_topic: Software strategy and open source contributions
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel aims to optimize AI frameworks and maintains the OpenVINO toolkit for deep learning inference. In 2024, Intel launched the Open Platform for Enterprise AI under the Linux Foundation and contributed oneAPI specifications to the UXL Foundation to enable open, multi-vendor programming across accelerators.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and Intel emphasize software strategies to accelerate generative AI adoption through open standards and toolkits. AVGO’s Tanzu Platform provides infrastructure for generative AI applications, while Intel launched the 'Open Platform for Enterprise AI' under the Linux Foundation to accelerate deployment of generative AI use cases and maintains the OpenVINO toolkit for deep learning inference.

comparisons.peer_topic: Mobile Business Unit product portfolio and AI enablement
comparisons.peer_summary: The MBU offers memory and storage products including NAND, DRAM, and MCPs, featuring unique firmware designed to accelerate AI applications in the mobile market.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and MU disclose firmware and software features specifically designed to accelerate AI applications, though in different hardware segments. AVGO’s Tanzu Platform offers platform engineering and AI solutions for cloud-based application delivery. MU’s Mobile Business Unit offers firmware features designed to accelerate AI applications in the mobile market, specifically for smartphones.
